description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveComment entity class for the OrangeHRM system. The class models comments associated with leave requests, including properties like ID, leave reference, creation timestamp, creator (user and employee), and comment text. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes methods for accessing and modifying these properties.

classes.name: LeaveComment
classes.description: Entity class representing comments related to leave requests in the OrangeHRM system, with properties for ID, associated leave, creation metadata, creator details, and comment content.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave comment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the leave comment.

methods.name: getLeave
methods.description: Returns the Leave entity associated with the comment.

methods.name: setLeave
methods.description: Associates a Leave entity with the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the comment was created.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp for the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who created the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee who created the comment.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the text of the comment.
